_about: Every sprite in the game. `request` is sent as-is to Retro Diffusion (POST /v2/inferences); `kind`, `frame` and `directions` tell the game how to use it. `derive` makes a FREE palette-swapped copy of another sprite (villagers from the hero, monster variants, tree/tile variants) — the game builds it at load time. A derive with `layers` is stacked from paper-doll layers instead (art/sprites PNGs from tools/hero_layers.py, bottom first), each recoloured by its own `recolor` or else the derive's: quest givers keep their hair on a layer of its own, so every shade of it takes the colour. A derived sprite with a `request` can be upgraded to its own art with `python3 tools/rd.py generate <id>`; `make art` skips derived ones. Anything not generated or derived yet shows as placeholder pixel art. Gameplay data (stats, maps, quests) lives in content/. See docs/ART_PLAN.md for the budget.
